objective: Gate 16L: auditoría transversal READ_ONLY de CAVAS V1 posterior a Gate16K. Certificar de forma integral arquitectura, SQL canónico, RBAC/scope por unidad, socios/personas/clientes, botellas, inventario inicial, Kardex/movimientos, consumos/cargos, evidencias, migración/adapters, auditoría física/ciega, reportes y contratos de interoperabilidad. Ejecutar únicamente pruebas unitarias/no mutantes, auditoría SQL SELECT y auditoría de repositorio. No modificar archivos, no DDL/DML, no Producción. Emitir evidencia suficiente para decidir los últimos gates de cierre hacia CAVAS V1 GLOBAL 100%.

queries.name: cavas_tables_present
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name LIKE 'CavaSocios[_]%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: cavas_critical_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('CavaSocios_Socios','CavaSocios_Botellas','CavaSocios_Movimientos','CavaSocios_Cargos') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: duplicate_socios_by_unit_number
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE NumeroSocio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EmpresaID,NumeroSocio HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1

queries.name: orphan_bottles
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS orphan_bottles FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas b LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Socios s ON s.SocioID=b.SocioID AND s.EmpresaID=b.EmpresaID WHERE b.SocioID IS NOT NULL AND s.SocioID IS NULL

queries.name: cross_scope_bottle_socios
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS cross_scope_rows FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas b JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Socios s ON s.SocioID=b.SocioID WHERE b.EmpresaID<>s.EmpresaID

queries.name: orphan_movements
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS orphan_movements FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos m LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas b ON b.BotellaID=m.BotellaID AND b.EmpresaID=m.EmpresaID WHERE m.BotellaID IS NOT NULL AND b.BotellaID IS NULL

queries.name: orphan_persona_links
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS orphan_persona_links FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios s LEFT JOIN dbo.Gobierno_Persona p ON p.PersonaID=s.PersonaID WHERE s.PersonaID IS NOT NULL AND p.PersonaID IS NULL

queries.name: cavas_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios) AS socios,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas) AS botellas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos) AS movimientos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos) AS cargos

constraints: No SQL mutation, DDL or DML
No Mongo as source of truth
No automatic inventory adjustment from blind audit
No provider hardcode in Cavas domain
No opening Gate16M until this Gate is PASS and 100%
